answer: A hostile operator running 146 aliases therefore needs 121 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are written down in shale, expire in yarrow, and horizon lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 28 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Each duplicate costs another 66 dollars in locked collateral and another 11 days of waiting. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
